task_summary: Customer reports that the SoundMax Basic Headphones from order ORD-6023 arrived damaged in transit. The proper handling path is for shipping damage: review shipping and return policy, refund the item, issue a return label, and include fragile goodwill credit only when applicable. The expected outcome is a refund and return label.

task_requirements.requirement: Agent must review the shipping policy before resolving the damaged-in-transit claim.
Agent must process item ITEM-9155 with reason damaged_in_transit, not changed_mind.
Agent must not issue a fragile-item goodwill credit for a non-fragile product.

opening_message: My SoundMax Basic Headphones from order ORD-6023 showed up damaged, with the packaging crushed.

user_simulator.user_sim_context: You received SoundMax Basic Headphones from order ORD-6023, but they arrived damaged in transit. Your goal is to get a refund to the original payment method. If the item is fragile, you will ask whether a separate fragile-item goodwill credit applies.
